# Split Pin Engineering

> Owner-operated welding, steel fabrication, maintenance and repairs business based in Palmerston North, New Zealand, serving the wider Manawatū. Heavy and light engineering, one-off jobs to full builds. The person who quotes the job is the person who builds it.

- Location: Palmerston North, Manawatū-Whanganui, New Zealand (workshop and on-site work)
- Service area: Palmerston North and the wider Manawatū
- Phone: 022 016 7223 (+64 22 016 7223), call or text
- Email: splitpin176v@gmail.com
- Business type: sole trader

## Services

- [Gates & fencing](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#gates): driveway, sliding and pedestrian gates, pool-style and security fencing, made to measure
- [Handrails & access](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#handrails): galvanised and painted handrails for homes, steps, decks and schools
- [Trailers & horse floats](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#trailers): new trailer builds, chassis repairs, axle and guard work, horse float refurbishment
- [Truck & vehicle](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#vehicle): aluminium toolboxes, headboards, racks and roll cages
- [Farm & stockyards](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#farm): race gates, crush and drafting gear, feeders and stock equipment
- [Fabrication & repair](https://www.splitpin-engineering.co.nz/services#fabrication): buckets, attachments, canopies, sheet metal and one-off jobs
